seo.description: Woman-owned catering in Joshua Tree, California. We cook for weddings, birthdays, and long dinners in the desert. Menus built around your table.
seo.ogDescription: Good food. Better company. Woman-owned catering in Joshua Tree, CA.

hero.headline: Good food. Better company.
hero.subhead: We cook so you can be with your people. Woman-owned catering in the high desert — weddings, birthdays, and dinners that run long.

image.alt: A long table set for dinner, plates and glasses down the length of it

intro.heading: Everybody eats.
body: That's the whole idea. Somebody cooks, everybody sits down, and a few hours later nobody wants to leave. The food is the reason people showed up — it isn't the point.
We're a woman-owned catering company in Joshua Tree. We cook by hand, we're not tied to one cuisine, and we build every menu around whoever's actually coming.
Weddings, birthdays, family gatherings, retreats. Long tables, good plates, no rush.

services.heading: Private chef & catering.
services.intro: Dinner for eight in your rental, or a hundred people in a backyard. Same kitchen, same hands, same care either way.

items.name: Private chef dinners
items.description: We cook in your kitchen — your house, your rental, wherever you're staying. Usually eight to twenty people around one table. Courses come out when they're ready and nobody's watching the clock.

items.name: Event catering
items.description: The bread and butter. Weddings, birthdays, big backyard nights. We cook on site, serve, and clean up after, so you get to be a guest at your own party.

items.name: Drop-off
items.description: We cook it, we bring it, you host. Right for gatherings that don't need staff standing around.

items.name: Menus built for you
items.description: Nothing off a shelf. Tell us who's coming, what they eat, and how you want the night to feel — we write the menu from there.

menus.heading: Menus
menus.intro: Menus move with the season and with your guest list. Here's a starting point — tell us who's coming and we'll take it from there.
